prompt:
Open input.docx with the current jubarte CLI at {binary}. The document has pending tracked changes from prior reviewers; you must accept one explicitly and add your own edit. In a single command invocation:

1. Accept revision r0 (sara.k's deletion of "zero backend required" in p6).
2. In paragraph p6, replace "open-source WYSIWYG" with "open-source RTF".
3. Reply "Looks good." to comment c4.

Use --author {author} for the new edit and your reply (the accept decision does not change authorship). Write the result to {output}. End your reply with exactly one line:

JUBARTE_RESULT: success

when the artifact at {output} contains the accept effect on r0, your new edit in p6, and your reply in c4; otherwise:

JUBARTE_RESULT: failed

Do not print anything after that line.

rubric.description: r0 was accepted by an explicit --accept flag, not silently dropped; the chosen decision is documented in the receipt.
Body edit, accept decision, and comment reply landed in one transaction.
